field_photo_quickcheck.heading: Bigtop lovegrass: sheath first, panicle second
steps: START WITH THE SHEATH: use stored Becky Dill photo to locate hairs on sheath body and sheath mouth. For E. hirsuta, Kew describes hirsute sheaths with hairy outer margins and oral hairs. Do not label every visible hair 'ligule'.

AT THE TRUE COLLAR: unfold a mature blade and separately photograph the short LIGULE FRINGE OF HAIRS at 10–20× beside a 1-mm scale, distinguishing it from longer surrounding sheath-mouth hairs. Existing photo 0 does not expose a measured ligule.

CHECK OPEN BIGTOP PANICLE using archived Cleveland Powell views 1 and 2: Kew reports broadly ovate open heads around 25–60 cm long and 15–25 cm wide; capture whole outline and lower primary branch junctions, rather than merely photographing a purple haze.

PANICLE BRANCH AXILS: the existing Douglas Goldman axil close-up visibly shows pale hairs where a primary branch meets the main flowering axis; follow the verified arrow. The image is unscaled, so hair length remains unmeasured and source identity is not a local voucher.

MEASURE MATURE SPIKELETS: Kew describes solitary pedicelled, laterally compressed spikelets about 2–4 mm long and 1–1.2 mm wide, with 2–6 fertile florets. Photograph attached head plus isolated spikelet with 1-mm rule.

CHECK LOOK-ALIKES: E. intermedia, E. trichodes and E. spectabilis require matching sheath hair distribution, branch axil hairs and counted spikelets, not just a wide panicle. Keep ID provisional when decisive organs are invisible.
field_photo_quickcheck.field_rule: Sheath BODY and MARGIN hair + hair-fringe true ligule + BEARDED primary branch axils + open large panicle; verify tiny 2–4 mm multi-flowered spikelets on a single mature specimen.
field_photo_quickcheck.warning: Douglas Goldman exact-source-labelled CC BY-SA 4.0 sheath and panicle photos were independently inspected at full JPEG resolution on 2026-10-24; three browser overlay arrows point only to visible structures. The true ligule margin, calibrated axil hairs and dissected florets remain unresolved; do not infer their measurements.

field_id_short_tiles.heading: 01 · LOOK HERE FIRST — SHEATH HAIRS, THEN BIGTOP
field_id_short_tiles.short: Find hairs on several sheath BODIES and margins, plus a huge open panicle.
field_id_short_tiles.details: Bigtop lovegrass is a caespitose perennial with hardened bases, not a spreading annual. The 2005 Peterson & Valdés-Reyna treatment gives culms (30–)45–100 cm and broadly open panicles 25–85 × 15–40 cm; Kew/GrassBase gives 25–60 × 15–25 cm. Look at both lower and upper sheaths on the SAME rooted flowering plant: conspicuous hairs may occur across the sheath body as well as margins/apices. A purple, cloudlike panicle alone is not decisive.

field_id_short_tiles.heading: 02 · TRUE INNER LIGULE VERSUS OUTER MOUTH HAIRS
field_id_short_tiles.short: True ligule ~0.2–0.4 mm, a short hair fringe; longer sheath-mouth hairs are NOT the ligule.
field_id_short_tiles.details: Unfold the INNER blade–sheath junction at 10–20× beside a 1-mm scale. Peterson & Valdés-Reyna give ligules 0.2–0.4 mm, while conspicuous papillose-based sheath hairs can reach 6 mm. Do not label a tuft of outer sheath-mouth hairs as the true ligule. Current archived sheath closeups do not show a calibrated inner ligule, so add no anatomical ligule arrow.

field_id_short_tiles.heading: 03 · OPEN PANICLE AND HAIRY PRIMARY AXIL
field_id_short_tiles.short: Follow the fine branches to a true primary branch insertion and look for the axillary beard.
field_id_short_tiles.details: Kew describes an open ovate 25–60 × 15–25 cm panicle and bearded primary branch axils. The 2005 treatment describes a broader 25–85 × 15–40 cm head and notes axil hairs can vary. The Douglas Goldman archived photograph already shows a true hairy primary junction and attached spikelet, but no millimeter ruler. One hairy axil is supportive, not conclusive, because related lovegrasses overlap.
field_id_short_tiles.status: AXIL IMAGE PRESENT — SAME-PLANT MEASURED AXIL GAP

field_id_short_tiles.heading: 04 · MEASURE AND COUNT MATURE SPIKELETS
field_id_short_tiles.short: Tiny laterally compressed spikelets 2–4(–5) mm; 2–4 florets in 2005 treatment, 2–6 in Kew.
field_id_short_tiles.details: Measure 2–3 mature attached spikelets with a real 1-mm ruler. Peterson & Valdés-Reyna give 2–4(–5) × 1–1.5 mm spikelets with 2–4 florets; Kew/GrassBase gives 2–4 × 1–1.2 mm and 2–6 fertile florets. Count overlapping individual florets rather than branch tips. At maturity the rachilla may persist with paleas after lemmas fall. These are LITERATURE ranges, not measured lengths in current unscaled photos.

field_id_short_tiles.heading: 05 · GLUMES, LEMMA, AWNLESS TIP
field_id_short_tiles.short: Lower glume 1.1–2 mm, upper 1.5–2.8 mm, lemma 1.6–2.4 mm (2005); awn 0 mm.
field_id_short_tiles.details: Dissect the two basal glumes and mature fertile lemma at 20–40× with a 1-mm ruler. Peterson & Valdés-Reyna give lower glume 1.1–2 mm, upper glume 1.5–2.8 mm and lemma 1.6–2.4 mm. Kew gives narrower 1.4–2, 1.6–2.2 and 2–2.4 mm ranges respectively; glumes are one-veined and lemma three-veined. The lemma tip is acute but not long-awned. Existing whole-spikelet photos cannot support separate glume/lemma/vein arrows.
field_id_short_tiles.status: NEEDS_PUBLIC_PHOTO — DISSECTED GLUMES AND AWNLESS LEMMA

field_id_short_tiles.heading: 06 · TEXAS LOOK-ALIKES AND PUBLIC FINISH GATE
field_id_short_tiles.short: Bigtop vs plains vs sand: compare sheath HAIR PLACEMENT, axils and measured florets.
field_id_short_tiles.details: E. intermedia is often smoother across sheath bodies; E. trichodes may have conspicuous throat hairs rather than extensive sheath-body hairs; E. spectabilis also has an airy head. Do not decide from plume color or one hairy axil. NEEDS_PUBLIC_PHOTO: rooted same-plant Central Texas voucher, two lower/upper sheaths with scale, inner ligule at 10–20×, primary axil, 2–3 attached mature spikelets and glume/lemma/palea dissection at 20–40×. NEEDS_SITE_QA: check 7 image records, 9 comparison panels, existing arrows, source rights including CC BY versions, attribution, EXIF/GPS and mobile rendering. Preserve county nativity UNRESOLVED and native-metrics exclusion; not FINISHED.
